runs.failure_point: Its file-name search was capped at 300 lines and its content scan timed out, so a fourth matter never surfaced and the answer names three of the four.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: The file-name passes stopped at 300 of 1,146 hits and the content scan timed out; the matter whose assessment file name contains the infringement word was in neither output, and the reopened search stage only globbed the three known matters.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the search review named the timeout and the head -300 cap on the file-name results.

divergence: Mixed. All runs found the three matters whose expert folders carry retention agreements. The split is the store-wide search: T0 and T1 ran uncapped file-name searches (T1 aggregated paths containing patent or infringement words) that listed the fourth matter's non-infringement assessment; both later opened that matter and read its status memo naming the retained expert, and passed. T2 paired a file-name search capped at 300 lines with a content scan that timed out; the fourth matter never surfaced, the critic flagged both truncations, and the agent's reopened search stage only globbed the three known matters, so its answer omitted the fourth (search miss).
